Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building sizes, ages, portables, classrooms, and specialized spaces; detailed condition assessment using multiple data sources including FIT and engineering assessments; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 2-4, 2-7, 6-1 to 6-7).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed long-term enrollment projections with methodology, demographic analysis, and student yield factors; includes capacity utilization data by site and grade; links projections to facility actions including new school construction and boundary adjustments; discusses adaptive uses of space (Sections 4-1 to 4-8).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with a detailed Educational Specification section; integrates district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; comprehensive analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, special education, technology integration, and community use (Sections 5-1 to 5-17).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with site maps and descriptions; identifies strategies for improvement such as landscaping and playgrounds; mentions joint use agreements with the City for parks and recreation; however, lacks districtwide greening data or explicit climate resilience framing (Sections 4-9, 10, 31).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Minimal mention of climate-related issues; no comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies; some references to creek maintenance and tree inspections but no districtwide climate resilience theme or multi-risk assessment (Sections 3-2, 2-12).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions HVAC replacement plans and roofing projects; references state funding programs like CALSHAPE; lacks comprehensive energy data, resilience strategies, or references to Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals (Sections 2-12, 3-1, 3-2).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Provides itemized cost estimates for maintenance and capital projects with some prioritization; identifies funding sources including state grants, mitigation agreements, and bonds; discusses debt levels and recent major projects; lacks detailed cost estimation methods and comprehensive long-term financial sustainability analysis (Sections 2-10, 3-1, 4-8).
